CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.can_write_optional_school(p_tenant_id uuid, p_school_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select
    case
      when p_school_id is null then safebus_private.can_write_tenant(p_tenant_id)
      else safebus_private.can_write_school(p_tenant_id, p_school_id)
    end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.can_write_route_stop(p_tenant_id uuid, p_route_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.routes r
    where r.id = p_route_id
      and r.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      and safebus_private.can_write_optional_school(r.tenant_id, r.school_id)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.current_driver_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select id
  from public.drivers
  where profile_id = auth.uid()
    and tenant_id = safebus_private.current_tenant_id()
    and status = 'active'
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.current_school_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p.school_id from public.profiles p
  where p.id = auth.uid() and p.status = 'active' and public.is_current_user_session_active()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.current_tenant_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p.tenant_id from public.profiles p
  join public.tenants t on t.id = p.tenant_id and t.status = 'active'
  where p.id = auth.uid() and p.status = 'active' and public.is_current_user_session_active()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.current_user_role()
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p.role
  from public.profiles p
  left join public.tenants t on t.id = p.tenant_id
  where p.id = auth.uid()
    and p.status = 'active'
    and p.role::text <> 'school_admin'
    and (p.role = 'platform_super_admin' or t.status = 'active')
    and public.is_current_user_session_active()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.has_completed_optional_mfa()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and (
    coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', 'aal1') = 'aal2'
    or (
      not exists (
        select 1 from public.profiles p
        where p.id = auth.uid()
          and p.role in ('tenant_admin', 'transportation_admin', 'platform_super_admin', 'school_admin')
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.profiles p
        join auth.mfa_factors f on f.user_id = p.id and f.status = 'verified'
        where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('guardian', 'driver')
      )
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.has_verified_mfa()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null
    and coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', 'aal1') = 'aal2';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.is_school_or_transportation_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    safebus_private.current_user_role() in ('school_admin', 'transportation_admin'),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.is_tenant_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(safebus_private.current_user_role() = 'tenant_admin', false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.is_transportation_write_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    safebus_private.current_user_role() in ('tenant_admin', 'school_admin', 'transportation_admin'),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.can_write_school(p_tenant_id uuid, p_school_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      safebus_private.current_user_role() in ('tenant_admin', 'transportation_admin')
      and p_tenant_id = safebus_private.current_tenant_id()
      and exists (select 1 from public.schools s where s.id = p_school_id and s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id)
    )
    or (
      safebus_private.current_user_role() = 'school_admin'
      and p_tenant_id = safebus_private.current_tenant_id()
      and p_school_id = safebus_private.current_school_id()
    ),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.can_write_tenant(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    safebus_private.current_user_role() in ('tenant_admin', 'school_admin', 'transportation_admin')
    and p_tenant_id = safebus_private.current_tenant_id(),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.driver_can_read_assigned_route(p_tenant_id uuid, p_route_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select
    auth.uid() is not null
    and safebus_private.current_user_role() = 'driver'
    and p_tenant_id = safebus_private.current_tenant_id()
    and p_route_id is not null
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.drivers d
      where d.id = safebus_private.current_driver_id()
        and d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        and d.status = 'active'
    )
    and (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.driver_route_assignments dra
        where dra.route_id = p_route_id
          and dra.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          and dra.driver_id = safebus_private.current_driver_id()
          and dra.status = 'active'
          and (dra.effective_from is null or dra.effective_from <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Edmonton')::date))
          and (dra.effective_to is null or dra.effective_to >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Edmonton')::date))
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.driver_trips dt
        where dt.route_id = p_route_id
          and dt.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          and dt.driver_id = safebus_private.current_driver_id()
          and dt.status = 'active'
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.is_tenant_delete_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    safebus_private.current_user_role() in (
      'platform_super_admin',
      'tenant_admin'
    ),
    false
  );
$function$
